headline: Morris Caps Overtime Drive as Tennessee Outlasts Ohio State 35-29
dek: The Volunteers stay perfect at 3-0 and atop the Eastern Southern while the Buckeyes fall to 1-2 and drop six spots in the power poll.
body: Overtime, third and less than four at the Ohio State seven, 8:09 on the clock — George MacIntyre drops back, finds Amari Jefferson crossing the end zone for a seven-yard touchdown, and Tennessee 35, Ohio State 29. The Volunteers had answered a 26-yard Jayden Fielding field goal with 16 seconds left in regulation by marching 79 yards in 1:37, MacIntyre hitting Joakim Dodson on a 40-yard strike and then a two-yard touchdown pass to knot it at 29, but the extra period belonged to the ground game: Tennessee ran the ball on every snap, grinding down to the seven before MacIntyre hit Jefferson for the winner.

Ohio State struck first, a 42-yard Fielding field goal at 13:40 of the first quarter, then Quinshon Judkins punched in a nine-yard run at 5:45 for a 10-0 lead. Tennessee answered with a 13-play, 73-yard drive, Morris scoring from two yards out and the two-point conversion good to make it 10-8 at 4:25 of the second. Fielding added a 33-yarder before halftime for a 13-8 Buckeye edge. A 39-yard Fielding kick pushed it to 16-8 at 9:14 of the third before MacIntyre found Braylon Staley on a one-yard touchdown and another two-pointer tied it at 16. Kyle Parker's 20-yard catch put Ohio State up 23-16 early in the fourth; Morris answered with a three-yard run at 6:31. Fielding's 45-yarder made it 26-23 at 3:07, then MacIntyre hit Dodson on a 40-yard bomb and a two-yard touchdown for a 29-26 Tennessee lead at 1:07. Fielding's 26-yarder with 16 seconds left forced overtime.

Tennessee won the yardage battle 446-351 and dominated time of possession 38:06 to 28:58, converting 9 of 14 third downs and all three fourth-down tries. MacIntyre threw for 346 yards and three touchdowns against two interceptions, pushing his season total to 1,071 yards — still the PCFL lead — while Travis Smith's 17-yard overtime catch lifted him to 392 receiving yards, also tops in the league. Morris, the Player of the Game, scored three touchdowns and keyed the overtime ground assault. Ohio State's Sayin passed for 259 yards and a touchdown with two picks, and Judkins managed just 29 yards on seven carries. The Buckeyes' five Fielding field goals kept them close, but two interceptions and zero fumble recoveries left them minus-two in turnover margin.

Tennessee improves to 3-0, holds the No. 1 power-poll spot and leads the Eastern Southern with a three-game win streak, averaging 32 points per game on offense and allowing 326.7 yards on defense — second in the league. Ohio State drops to 1-2, falls to No. 12 in the poll and sits third in the Western Central behind division-leading Notre Dame, having lost two straight while allowing 35 points and 370.3 yards per game on defense. Next week the Volunteers host Arkansas (2-1); the Buckeyes welcome UCLA (1-2) in a must-win for their division hopes.
turningPoint: Overtime, 8:09 remaining, third and less than four at the Ohio State seven — MacIntyre's seven-yard touchdown pass to Amari Jefferson gave Tennessee a 35-29 lead that stood as the final margin.
byTheNumbers: Tennessee held the ball 38:06 to 28:58, converted 64% of third downs and was perfect on fourth down (3-for-3), wearing down an Ohio State defense that allows 370.3 yards per game.
MacIntyre's 346 passing yards pushed his season total to 1,071, maintaining the PCFL lead in passing yards.
Ohio State kicker Jayden Fielding made all five field-goal attempts (42, 33, 39, 45, 26 yards), providing 15 of the Buckeyes' 29 points.
Tennessee rushed for 105 yards on the night, with Daune Morris scoring three touchdowns, while Ohio State managed just 101 rushing yards and Quinshon Judkins was held to 29 yards on seven carries.

unsungHero.name: Jayden Fielding
unsungHero.why: He made all five field-goal attempts, including a 45-yarder and the 26-yarder that forced overtime, keeping Ohio State within striking distance despite the offense stalling in the red zone.
